text.content:
President of the NUSA for three decades.

Role: Former President, NUSA
Status: Stepped down in 2053
Known for: Nationalizing Militech; blaming Arasaka for the 2023 bomb

Kress nationalized Militech after the 4th Corporate War and blamed Arasaka in public for the 2023 bomb for twenty-four years. In 2025 she struck a personal deal with Michiko Arasaka that became Danger Gal. When Trace Santiago's exposé was finally believed in 2047, five years of hearings followed, and in 2053 she stepped down under a new Constitution.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 05
